who: Historian of early North America and the French Atlantic, formerly William & Mary; PhD history, California, Davis, 2003.

The university library catalogue identifies Brett H. Rushforth's Savage Bonds as a history PhD dissertation at California, Davis, 2003.
The candidate's LC record identifies Brett Rushforth as an early modern Atlantic historian and former history professor at William & Mary and Oregon.

notes: Direct advisee match, matching doctorate, and the LC career note establish the identity.
